resolve_disembargo.note: Reflected-capability resolve/embargo. Per-direction skips are reference-library gaps, not capnp-zig behavior; recorded as SKIP by tools/e2e_runner.zig (resolveDisembargoSkip). See docs/supported-surface.md Known limitations #4.

zig-client_to_reference-server.reason: pycapnp cannot host the reflecting server (no promise-fulfiller API to return an unresolved capability and resolve it later).

reference-client_to_zig-server.reason: reference client cannot consume Zig's Level-1 takeFromOtherQuestion loopback return: go-capnp cannot parse it; capnp-rpc parses it but only completes when the forwarded call used sendResultsTo=yourself, so it hangs.
